title: Proposal - Basic EVM Tools for Edgeware Network
body:
The goal of this proposal is to develop some EVM tools for the Edgeware network.

**Cross Chain EVM Bridge - Complete**

![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/40b0e851-9951-4fb9-95ba-8a0ce808e7eb.1669923512268)

![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/457ff3b4-629a-4e27-9494-d3be65e4aa4e.1669923618641)   
We needed a cross-chain bridge for both substrate and EVM to scale the IDO launchpad and future projects to other blockchains; finally, the EVM bridge is complete. 
Currently, it supports all popular EVM blockchains. Anyone can add liquidity to the bridge.
The substrate-to-EVM bridge is in the works.

EVM Bridge : [https://evm-bridge.edgeverse.exchange](https://evm-bridge.edgeverse.exchange)

Suggest to me some of your favorite tokens you want to see on Edgeware and the blockchains you want to add Edgeware Token to. We can list EDG on all popular EVM DEXs, and it will also create more utility for Edgeware Token.
We used multichain.org open-source code with a few small changes. You can check the sources of smart contracts after deployment and compare them with the verified AnySwap contracts. We are upgrading Edgscan to support the smart contract verification service. Hybrid Block Explorer also has smart contract verification support.
